name: Independent Variation Principle (IVP) software architecture papers

mentions.name: Independent Variation Principle (IVP) software architecture papers
mentions.description: A pair of academic papers presenting a new unifying theory of software architecture based on the Independent Variation Principle (IVP), which evaluates how constructs with different change drivers are decoupled. One paper targets the IEEE ICSA 2026 conference research track and a long-form paper is published on Zenodo.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on my two papers about a new unifying theory of software architecture based on the "Independent Variation Principle" (IVP) (one paper for IEEE ICSA 2026 conf, Research track - I hope it will be accepted, and a long-form paper already on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17677316).
